fact: The GRA Commissioner General said the new Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) will let taxpayers register, file returns, pay and access services online, with stakeholder workshops held ahead of rollout.

GRA and the Ministry of Finance signed a USD 7.27 million, 24-month World Bank-funded contract with the Arabsoft-TMI Consortium to implement the Integrated Tax Administration System, which the finance minister said will cover how taxes are registered, filed, paid, audited and enforced.

A joint Ministry of Finance and GRA press release says the World Bank-supported ITAS, to provide online services, is being implemented, with an Arabsoft and Tunisie Micro-Informatique consortium selected at USD 7,270,192.20 after the first awardee went bankrupt.

The Gambia Revenue Authority signed an agreement with Sogema Technologies for a web-based Integrated Tax Administration System with online filing, replacing GAMTAXNET, after a tender launched in 2023 following a business process re-engineering.
